text: The clinic was very clean, and the doctor gave excellent advice.

My first visit was very impressive, especially the doctor and the staff. The doctor was very friendly, fun to talk to, and provided knowledge while treating me. The price was affordable and very good value. The technology at the clinic is more advanced than many other places; it's like a budget-friendly hospital. I highly recommend this place to others; you won't be disappointed.

Quick check-up, fast results, friendly doctor who's fun to chat with.
I was diagnosed with the flu, received an injection, and got medication from the clinic. After taking it overnight, my fever went down and my symptoms improved very quickly. The clinic looks clean. Highly recommended.
I was seen in minutes, no appointment necessary, a warm welcome, and excellent service! Tests were done on-site, and results were available immediately. I highly recommend it!
The doctors, nurses, and all the staff provided excellent service.

Unfortunately, I caught tonsillitis with a fever during my trip to Thailand. This doctor was my greatest savior! At this friendly practice, I received immediate help. Thanks to the IV I received right away, I felt significantly better the next day! The two follow-up appointments were also excellent. The medication was readily available at the practice, and the doctor was one of the best I have ever seen. Waiting times were minimal! I highly recommend this practice!

We were fortunate enough to find this clinic when our fever from a bladder infection didn't subside despite antibiotics. The doctor and nurses were professional and efficient. At the clinic, we had blood tests and an ultrasound, after which we thoroughly discussed treatment options with the doctor. He speaks good English, which was helpful. The treatment went very well, and we were soon able to enjoy our vacation again. We definitely recommend M square polyclinic!

Very good doctors and staff. I have been about 10 times and at all visits got prompt service, high class and super friendly. Even the prices are cheap as well for the treatment as the pharmacy. How lucky i am i found this clinic, the best i have seen in Thailand.

I came here on a recommendation from my sibling.
My first time here and I felt the care and attention given.
They provided helpful advice.
After my first treatment, my neck pain improved.
Shock wave therapy is very effective.

Attentive and kind doctors and nurses. They gave us the care we needed after we got into a scooter accident, and made sure to follow up and provide good instructions for how to take care of our injuries at home after the clinic. Very knowledgeable and helpful. Highly recommend!

Today I received my second shingles vaccine dose. The price was very reasonable. I was impressed with everything here. The clinic is spotlessly clean and hygienic. The doctor is kind and skilled. All the staff and team members are polite, always smiling, welcoming, and attentive. Many of the pieces of equipment and tools are new and modern. I even peeked in when the doctor wasn't looking :) Hehe :) Oh... and there's plenty of convenient parking.
The service was excellent. My skin improved after the treatment. The staff were very friendly and helpful.
The new clinic is clean, the care is good, and the prices are reasonable. There's parking available across the street next to the 7-Eleven.
I received physiotherapy here. It was convenient, the prices were affordable, and the physiotherapists were friendly.

Getting my flu shot at M Square Polyclinic was great! I was impressed. It was quick, no long queues, not crowded, they have a giant air purifier, and even offer coffee. The price is good, and there's plenty of parking. Highly recommend!

🤩 Importantly, they also have a concentrated flu vaccine for seniors! 😆

- Regular flu vaccine: 590 baht per dose, all-inclusive.
- Concentrated flu vaccine for seniors: 2,000 baht individually, 1,900 baht per person for a pair.

I wasn't feeling well, so I went to see the doctor. The doctor ordered a blood test, and the results came back in 20 minutes – very quick! I received medication from the doctor right away. It was much faster than going to the hospital. The clinic was also very clean. I really liked it.
I received treatment from Dr. Thanya. He's very kind and friendly. The medication is cheaper than some other hospitals. I'm very impressed. They have all the necessary equipment. Excellent!
